title: Tagine with Olives
description: A simple Moroccan-inspired keto dish featuring tender lamb and flavorful olives.
instructions: Season lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Heat coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add tagine spice mix and cook for another minute.
Add lamb shoulder back to the pot and transfer to preheated oven.
Braise lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Add green olives to the pot and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Serve lamb shoulder with olives and sauce spooned over the top.
